messages:
Eran: flagging weird quota divergence for a few tenants, looks like client libs are sending route tags in different shapes again :grimacing:
Bea: example payloads?
Eran: python -> `route_tags: [\"billing:high\"]`, ts -> `route_tags: \"billing:high,infra\"` (comma string), go -> `Route-Tags: \"billing:high\"` (header case + single string)
Tom: oof. the console heatmap is splitting counts by exact tag shape/case which fragments quotas and makes reconciliation hard
Ravi: short term: ingest shim that normalizes header/casing and parses comma-separated strings into arrays. add `route_tag_shape:migration` tag on events
Maya: console: i'll add a temporary rollup that merges the shapes for charts and surface a per-client-version breakdown. also add an alert if >0.5% tokens become unattributed for a tenant during rollout
Bea: SDK owners: propose these changes
  - TS: parse user-provided string and serialize to array on send (v0.9.3)
  - Go: normalize header name to canonical `route_tags` and emit array (v1.4.1)
  - Python: already emitting array, add unit test to guard regression
Eran: timeline? we need the shim live before SDKs cut so we don't impact customers
Tom: I'll land the proxy shim today, canary 5% at 16:00 PT. It will do: header canonicalization, comma-split, trim whitespace, handle empty values, and tag events with `route_tag_shape:normalized`
Ravi: SDK PRs should include a small runtime WARN logged once per process when they encounter legacy-style strings, with guidance to upgrade. Also include an integration test that posts to the shim
Maya: console changes deployed to staging. adding `route_tag_shape` metric and dashboard tile. ETA 30m for prod deploy after canary looks ok
release-bot: deploy scheduled: route-tags-normalizer-canary -> 2026-03-23 16:00 PT, 5% traffic, release id: r-49980-rtag
Tom: monitoring `quota.unattributed` and `route_tag_shape.legacy_count`. if legacy_count drops and unattributed drops we roll to 50% in 30m
Bea: i'll draft release notes and a short #devex post with code snippets showing TS/Go migration. include a note: "no action for python users"
Ravi: PRs opened: ts#589 (serializes array, tests), go#121 (header normalization), both target next minor releases. tagging devex and eng-platform for review
Eran: huge thanks. follow up: remove shim after 2 weeks once `route_tag_shape.legacy_count` < 0.1% and update reconciliation job to ignore legacy shapes afterwards
Maya: noted. will keep migration metric for 21 days and then re-evaluate
Bea: ping here when canary reaches 50% so we can finalize the public notes
Tom: canary healthy at 20m, rolling to 50% now. early signal: unattributed down ~95% on canary traffic :tada:
Eran: perfect. closing loop soon.
